title: DNS: Switch to Shecan
description: Configure Shecan DNS (178.22.122.100, 185.51.200.2) on the active default route interface via resolvectl.
command: pkexec resolvectl dns $(ip route show default | awk '{print $5}' | head -n1) 178.22.122.100 185.51.200.2 && resolvectl status | grep -A 3 "DNS Servers"

title: DNS: Switch to Cloudflare (1.1.1.1)
description: Configure fast Cloudflare DNS (1.1.1.1, 1.0.0.1) on the active default route interface via resolvectl.
command: pkexec resolvectl dns $(ip route show default | awk '{print $5}' | head -n1) 1.1.1.1 1.0.0.1 && resolvectl status | grep -A 3 "DNS Servers"

title: DNS: Reset to Automatic (DHCP)
description: Revert custom per-interface DNS settings back to automatic DHCP and flush systemd-resolved caches.
command: pkexec resolvectl revert $(ip route show default | awk '{print $5}' | head -n1) && resolvectl flush-caches && echo "DNS reverted to automatic and cache flushed."

title: Network & VPN IP Check
description: Inspect external public IP geolocation/ASN metadata via ipinfo.io and list all active local network interfaces.
command: curl -s https://ipinfo.io/json && echo "" && echo "--- Active Interfaces ---" && ip -br addr

title: Flush DNS & Socket Cache
description: Immediately flush systemd-resolved DNS lookup caches.
command: resolvectl flush-caches && echo "Systemd-resolved DNS cache flushed successfully."

title: Docker Full Prune
description: Deep clean all unused Docker containers, dangling/unreferenced images, networks, and volumes.

title: Top 10 Heavy Directories in Home
description: Scan your home folder (max-depth 2) and rank the largest space-consuming directories.

title: ADB Connected Devices & Battery
description: List attached Android Debug Bridge devices and query real-time battery level & charging status.
command: adb devices -l && adb shell dumpsys battery | grep -E "level|status"

title: Systemd Failed Services Check
description: Check all systemd units currently in a failed or degraded state.

title: Disk SMART & Partition Health
description: Display filesystem type, total size, used space, and mount points for all physical partitions.
